name: Lewd Sibling Duo
source:
LSD features two main protagonists, brother - a prominent young biologist, and his older sister - a college professor. On a quest to rid the population of a terrible infertility plague that threatens the very existence of humanity, they discover that their solution has some interesting side effects on women.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/mmeier]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《LSD》有兩名主角：一名傑出的年輕生物學家，以及他的姊姊、一名大學教授。為了消除威脅人類生存的可怕不孕瘟疫，他們發現自己的解決方案對女性產生了一些有趣的副作用。

[來源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/mmeier]Patreon[/url]]
